summary_en: Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited completed a tender offer for SEED Co., acquiring 13,102,594 shares (46.8% of outstanding shares) at an unspecified price, with settlement scheduled for October 20, 2026. The bidder will become a major shareholder upon settlement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Tender Offer for Common Shares of SEED Co., Ltd. by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited and Changes in Principal Shareholders and Other Related Parties
translation_en_brief:
Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited completed a tender offer for SEED Co., Ltd. that ran from August 27 to October 13, 2026. The bidder received applications for 13,102,594 shares, representing 46.8% of outstanding shares (calculated as 13,102,594 divided by 27,990,000 shares excluding treasury stock). The offer satisfied the minimum acceptance threshold of 5,408,800 shares and will proceed to settlement on October 20, 2026.

Upon settlement completion on October 20, 2026, Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited will hold voting rights equal to or exceeding 20% of SEED's total voting rights and will be classified as a major shareholder and related party. Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited was established on September 3, 2025, in the Cayman Islands and is 100% owned by Luxshare Precision Limited, a Hong Kong-based company. The disclosure confirms no capital relationship, personnel relationship, transaction relationship, or related-party status between SEED and the bidder prior to the offer.
